name: Swing
description: An intraday trend on a coin that has already proven it can hold a pool: medium size, thirds at +50% and +100%, a 25% trail, a 90-minute review, no hard stop (thesis breaks only).

fit.summary: 1 h to 7 d old; above VWAP with higher lows on the 1m candles; liquidity >= $30k and steady; holders not concentrated.
signals: liquidity steady or rising vs its 5-min high

hardStop.why: Recorded winners often dipped 10-25% before they ran, and a rug fills near -100% through any stop. The thesis-break rules and the size are the exit.

reentry.requires: a new full vet that passes

notes: Upgrade to runner only after TP1 filled with the price above it and every thesis check clean. Downgrade to scalp any time the trend weakens.

1.1.0 adds wake (the judgement calls that wake the position's agent session; noAnswer is what happens when no session answers in time) and maxHoldMinutes (a hard holding cap). Mechanical exits never wait for the session.
